about: Terbutaline tablets 5 mg (no Australian brand is listed, so the ingredient name is used) are supplied four times from December 2025 to March 2026 to a 71-year-old woman.
Terbutaline tablets 2.5 mg are supplied three times from January to March 2026, in the middle of a 15-month history of ordinary background medicines.
Terbutaline is supplied four times, but only as a Bricanyl Turbuhaler inhaler (breathed in), not as tablets or liquid by mouth, so it must not flag.
